# performance-methodology

Baseline-first performance work - measured baseline before claims, thresholds declared, benchmarks answer questions.

## Detected anti-patterns

### `AF-PERF-001` — Every list response carries a server-side bound (high)

Unbounded collections grow with data, not with design — p99 latency and memory degrade gradually then catastrophically, and the failure arrives long after the code shipped.

Remediation: Cap `limit` server-side with a documented maximum; default to a sane page size; measure page-query cost under production-like cardinality.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-agentic-platform.md

### `AF-PERF-003` — Conditional requests serve cache before compute (medium)

ETag/Last-Modified with 304 responses skip payload generation and transfer entirely for unchanged resources — free capacity already defined by the protocol.

Remediation: Emit `ETag` on cacheable GETs; honor `If-None-Match` with 304 before rendering; mark non-cacheable responses explicitly (`Cache-Control: no-store`) so intent is auditable.

Reference: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#name-conditional-requests

### `AF-PERF-004` — Compression is negotiated, not assumed (low)

JSON payloads compress 5-10x; serving them uncompressed burns egress and client latency, while double-compressing already-compressed content wastes CPU.

Remediation: Enable gzip/br content negotiation at the edge; measure per-endpoint savings; skip compression for tiny or binary responses.

Reference: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#name-content-encoding

### `AF-PERF-005` — Timeouts exist before retries, and retries carry jitter (high)

A retry without a timeout waits forever; retries without jitter synchronize into thundering herds. Order matters: connect/read timeouts first, bounded retries with exponential backoff + jitter second, circuit breaker third.

Remediation: Declare connect and total timeouts per dependency; cap attempts; add full jitter; stop retrying on 4xx and on open breakers.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-agentic-platform.md

### `AF-PERF-006` — A performance claim requires a measured baseline (medium)

"This is faster" without a baseline measurement is unfalsifiable; optimization work starts by recording current p50/p99, throughput and resource cost — the number the change must beat.

Remediation: Record baseline metrics with the load shape that produced them; rerun the identical shape after the change; report the delta, never the isolated number.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-agentic-platform.md

### `AF-PERF-007` — Sync work does not block the request path unnecessarily (medium)

Calls that outlive their value inside the request (emails, analytics, third-party writes with no response need) stretch p99 for work the caller never sees.

Remediation: Move fire-and-forget work behind a queue/event; keep in-path only calls whose results shape the response; document which downstream calls are on the critical path.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-agentic-platform.md
